definition: Restricted source CSV imported by preprocessing
description: Expected local input file at Data/Working NRH SCI.csv
derivation_or_transformation: Validated against validation/source_schema.csv and imported in full
validation_rules: must pass the strict public source contract
notes: Contains PHI/PII or restricted clinical data and must not be committed

definition: Generated Stata copy of the imported source CSV
derivation_or_transformation: Created from Working NRH SCI.csv

definition: Generated private analysis dataset consumed by paper and supplemental scripts
derivation_or_transformation: Created by variable cleaning and derivation in preprocessing

definition: Age at inpatient rehabilitation admission
description: Patient age at inpatient rehabilitation admission as analyzed in the cleaned dataset
derivation_or_transformation: Imported directly; age_decade is derived from this variable
validation_rules: must be nonnegative and nonmissing for included rows

definition: Age scaled by 10 for regression models
description: Primary age covariate for paper models
derivation_or_transformation: age / 10

definition: Male sex indicator
description: Descriptive covariate with female as the reference category
derivation_or_transformation: F=0; M and MALE=1; unlisted input rejected
notes: Female reference category; approved under NRH004-D002

definition: Post-discharge death indicator
description: Used in survival descriptions and Kaplan-Meier analyses
derivation_or_transformation: Explicit field mapping assigns N=0 and Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Rib fracture indicator
derivation_or_transformation: Explicit field mapping assigns N=0 and Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Pneumothorax indicator
derivation_or_transformation: Explicit field mapping assigns N=0 and Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Chest tube indicator
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; Y and both approved post-intubation affirmative literals=1; unlisted input rejected
notes: The current approved allowlist contains no documented unknown literal; NRH004-D003

definition: Reported cervical injury level before rehabilitation
description: Used to assess reclassification at rehabilitation admission
derivation_or_transformation: Explicit C1-C8 mapping to the corresponding numeric code; unlisted input rejected
validation_rules: must be an integer from 1 through 8 or missing

definition: Indicator of an attempted ventilator wean before tracheostomy
derivation_or_transformation: N and NO=0; Y and the documented extubation narrative exception=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Indicator of an attempted ventilator wean before transfer to rehabilitation
missing_values: blank or documented UNKNOWN or UNKOWN
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; Y and the documented night-ventilation narrative exception=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Indicator of pneumonia before inpatient rehabilitation admission
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; Y and YES=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Rehabilitation-assessed cervical injury level
description: Primary injury level measure used in grouping
derivation_or_transformation: Compound C1-C8 AIS input maps directly to the corresponding level code
validation_rules: must be an integer from 1 through 8 or missing

definition: AIS classification at inpatient rehabilitation admission
value_labels: 1 = AIS A | 2 = AIS B | 3 = AIS C | 4 = AIS D
derivation_or_transformation: Canonical AIS A-D map to 1-4; AIA A maps to AIS A and CENTRAL CORD maps to AIS D
validation_rules: must be an integer from 1 through 4 or missing

definition: Complete motor versus partial motor injury group
derivation_or_transformation: AIS A/B=Complete Motor; AIS C/D=Partial Motor

definition: High cervical injury group versus low cervical injury group
derivation_or_transformation: C1-C4=High; C5-C8=Low

readable_name: Initial high versus low cervical injury
definition: Initial pre-rehabilitation high/low injury group
derivation_or_transformation: C1-C4=High; C5-C8=Low

definition: Direction of injury-level change from pre-rehabilitation report to rehabilitation assessment
value_labels: 1 = Down (Lower Level) | 2 = No Change | 3 = Up (Higher Level)
derivation_or_transformation: Direct numeric comparison assigns the stable direction code

definition: Joint injury-level and motor-completeness category
value_labels: 0 = High, Complete Motor | 1 = High, Partial Motor | 2 = Low, Complete Motor | 3 = Low, Partial Motor
derivation_or_transformation: Direct four-level cross-classification
notes: Partial motor corresponds to AIS C/D

definition: Indicator for partial ventilator wean before inpatient rehabilitation admission
description: Used for the prespecified paper-analysis exclusion
missing_values: blank or documented UNKNOWN or UNKOWN
derivation_or_transformation: Only explicit prior-to-rehabilitation or prior-to-admission phrases=1; known non-prior states=0; unlisted input rejected
notes: Admission means inpatient rehabilitation admission; NRH004-D007

definition: Patient achieved daytime ventilator weaning
description: Milestone outcome used in tables and competing-risk analysis
missing_values: blank or documented UNKNOWN or UNKOWN
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; approved affirmative and prior-to-admission literals=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to daytime wean
missing_values: missing when not achieved or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: String timing field cleaned and destringed

definition: Patient achieved 24-hour liberation from invasive mechanical ventilation
description: Milestone outcome used in tables and competing-risk analysis
derivation_or_transformation: N and the documented nighttime BiPAP state=0; Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to 24-hour liberation from IMV
missing_values: missing when not achieved or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: Specific CPAP note recoded to 1 and destringed

definition: Patient achieved tracheostomy decannulation
description: Milestone outcome used in tables and competing-risk analysis
derivation_or_transformation: N and N.=0; Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to decannulation
missing_values: missing when not achieved or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: Used directly in paper and supplemental scripts
notes: Original long source variable name retained

definition: Ordinal respiratory outcome at rehabilitation discharge
description: Primary respiratory outcome in proportional-odds model
value_labels: 1 = Fully Vent Dependent | 2 = Weaned During Day | 3 = Liberated from IMV | 4 = Decannulated
missing_values: missing when no milestone state can be determined
derivation_or_transformation: Direct hierarchy assigns the highest achieved milestone with missing-value guards
validation_rules: must be ordered from more support to less support

definition: Indicator for transfer from rehabilitation to ICU
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; Y and the documented SICU narrative=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Indicator that ICU transfer was for a respiratory cause
derivation_or_transformation: N and the documented diaphragm-pacer narrative=0; Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Indicator for pneumonia during rehabilitation
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Ordinal discharge destination at rehabilitation discharge
description: Primary discharge outcome in proportional-odds model
value_labels: 1 = LTAC | 2 = SNF | 3 = Home w/ Home Health | 4 = Home
derivation_or_transformation: Explicit established source-label mapping assigns stable codes 1-4; unlisted input rejected
validation_rules: must be ordered from more resource-intensive to less resource-intensive
notes: Preserved behavior outside the eight NRH-004 decisions

definition: Binary discharge destination grouping
derivation_or_transformation: LTAC/SNF recoded to facility and home categories recoded to home
validation_rules: must be 1 or 2 when discharge_to present

definition: Indicator for admission from an outside hospital
derivation_or_transformation: N=0; Y=1; unlisted input rejected

definition: Calendar date of spinal cord injury
description: Used to derive admission and discharge dates
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed from trimmed text using the MD20Y mask

definition: Derived rehabilitation admission date
description: Used as origin for follow-up calculations
derivation_or_transformation: injury_date + daysfrominjurytoadmissiontorehab

definition: Derived rehabilitation discharge date
derivation_or_transformation: injury_date + daysfrominjurytoadmissiontorehab + daystodischargefromrehab

definition: Post-discharge death date when present
missing_values: missing for non-deceased or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed from trimmed text using the MD20Y mask
validation_rules: must parse as date when death is 1

readable_name: Follow-up to death or censoring from rehabilitation admission
definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to death or administrative censoring
derivation_or_transformation: date_death - date_admit if death; otherwise the numeric date derived from nrh_admin_censor_date_iso minus date_admit
notes: nrh_admin_censor_date_iso is 2023-09-30 and is controlled by NRH004-D008

readable_name: Follow-up to death or censoring from rehabilitation discharge
definition: Days from rehabilitation discharge to death or administrative censoring
derivation_or_transformation: date_death - date_discharge if death; otherwise the numeric date derived from nrh_admin_censor_date_iso minus date_discharge
notes: Changing the 2023-09-30 constant requires a new signed decision and full baseline review

definition: Finer cervical injury grouping used in author-response supplemental figures
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from level in the unchanged supplemental sensitivity script
notes: C8 is accepted prospectively and the C7-C8 grouping remains unchanged under NRH004-D004

definition: Reduced discharge category used in decannulated subgroup supplemental analysis
missing_values: missing for LTAC or non-decannulated subgroup rows
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from discharge_to for subgroup visualization/modeling

definition: Generated publication figure for daily ventilator-weaning and discharge states
derivation_or_transformation: Exported from stackedcount under Results and Figures/<run_id> (or <date> for direct legacy execution)
notes: May not be tracked in git

definition: Generated publication figure for proportional-odds models
derivation_or_transformation: Exported from coefplot under Results and Figures/<run_id> (or <date> for direct legacy execution)

definition: Generated supplemental figure for daytime wean liberation from IMV and decannulation
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from Fine-Gray models and graph combine under Results and Figures/<run_id> (or <date> for direct legacy execution)

definition: Generated publication Kaplan-Meier figure by discharge and weaning milestone
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from sts graph and graph combine under Results and Figures/<run_id> (or <date> for direct legacy execution)

derivation_or_transformation: Exported under Results and Figures/<run_id> (or <date> for direct legacy execution)
